limitations: Source snapshot is a simulator data set, not an operational or certified airport chart.
No invented connectors: unavailable stands and disconnected source components remain explicit.
AVISO gate labels are annotations; they are not used to invent stand lead-ins.
Named stand records map to an existing, identically named OSM endpoint only within 60m; original source positions and match distances are retained.
Runway destinations are existing runway/taxiway intersection nodes, not runway thresholds or ATC clearance limits.
All source runway edges are retained, but planners should exclude runway travel for ordinary taxi routes.
AVISO nonrouting reference lines include boundaries, stand markings and restriction lines; they do not extend the routing graph.
A source parking segment crossing an AVISO building interior is excluded from routing and retained as reference geometry.
